anomalies.description: Two men engage in a close-quarters physical fight: the man in red grabs and restrains the man in grey, who resists; the man in black (Ip Man) intervenes with defensive hand movements and blocks.; Two men engage in a physical fight: the man in grey lunges and is grabbed by the man in black, who then throws him to the ground.

After being overpowered, the man in grey is forcibly pushed down and held on the floor by the man in red, while the man in black observes; the victim is clearly subdued and unable to resist.; After being thrown down, the man in grey lies on the floor while the man in black stands over him; this constitutes abuse of a helpless victim during/after the fight.

Two men engage in a physical fight inside an office: the man in red initiates with a punch and a high kick (f0–f2), then is countered and grabbed by the man in black, who applies a chokehold (f8–f15). The struggle involves mutual engagement and dynamic exchange of offensive and defensive actions.
Two men engage in a physical fight: the man in black blocks and counters a punch from the man in red, then seizes his arm and begins to control him.

The man in black has fully subdued the man in red, applying a chokehold while the victim is helpless and visibly distressed; the attacker then uses his free hand to operate a rotary telephone, indicating the victim is incapacitated and unable to resist.; A man in black is choking another man in red who appears helpless and distressed; the attacker maintains a firm grip on the victim's neck throughout the sequence while simultaneously holding a telephone receiver to his ear.
A man holds a woman in a chokehold while pressing a knife-like object to her ear; she is visibly distressed and struggling, indicating a non-consensual violent act against a helpless victim.

A man in black restrains another man in red in a close physical struggle; the restrained man is held upright with his head tilted back, arms controlled, suggesting active mutual or one-sided combat that continues over several seconds.
